mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, title, source_ref, episode_count, status, quality_score, adaptation_plan, quality_report, created_at, updated_at FROM story_script_draft WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, project_id, title, source_ref, episode_count, status, quality_score, adaptation_plan, quality_report, created_at, updated_at FROM story_script_draft WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_script_draft (project_id, title, source_ref, episode_count, status, quality_score, adaptation_plan, quality_report, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{sourceRef}, #{episodeCount}, #{status}, #{qualityScore}, #{adaptationPlan}::jsonb, #{qualityReport}::jsonb, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE story_script_draft SET title = #{title}, source_ref = #{sourceRef}, episode_count = #{episodeCount}, status = #{status}, quality_score = #{qualityScore}, adaptation_plan = #{adaptationPlan}::jsonb, quality_report = #{qualityReport}::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
